annotations.title: JSON array of objects to CSV (nested objects flattened to dot.keys)

description: JSON array of objects to CSV (nested objects flattened to dot.keys). Converts an array of objects (or arrays) to CSV with a header row built from the union of keys. Nested objects become dot.separated columns, arrays are JSON-encoded, and cells starting with = + - @ are escaped against spreadsheet formula injection. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
